build_serialize_vllm_model: build a function to serialize a vLLM model to tensorizer format with encryption and S3 support
load_deserialize_model: deserialize a tensorizer-serialized vLLM model into a PyTorch module with GPU acceleration
create_tensorizer_config: create a TensorizerConfig dataclass with URI, encryption, S3 credentials, and serialization options
test_is_vllm_tensorized: test whether a serialized model file is a vLLM tensorized model by checking for vllm_tensorized_marker
run_tensorize_lora_adapter: run tensorization of a LoRA adapter from safetensors format to tensorizer binary format
